name: Airport Authority Hong Kong Marine Ecology Enhancement Fund
summary: Independent fund set up under the Three-Runway System environmental permit to back third-party initiatives that improve marine ecology, including Chinese White Dolphins, in western Hong Kong waters and the Pearl River Estuary.

geography.label: Hong Kong western waters and Pearl River Estuary

status.quote: Results of the applications of projects funded by the Marine Ecology Enhancement Fund for Year 2026/27 are released.

opens.quote: 01/12/2025 The Marine Ecology Enhancement Fund is now open for application.

deadline.quote: Deadline of application for Year 2026/27 is 31 January 2026.

applicant_types.quote: to fund initiatives proposed by third-parties (e.g. Non-governmental organisations (NGOs), researchers and the fishery sector)

geography.quote: in Hong Kong western waters and further afield into the Pearl River Estuary (PRE)
